attackers_goals: Gain code execution on the host and evade security controls.
description: SearchProtocolHost.exe has been launched from a process that is different from SearchIndexer.exe This may indicate malicious activity (such as malware later being injected to it, or it being used for phantom DLL hijacking).
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Suspicious SearchProtocolHost.exe parent process
